title: OP Kill All Bring All Jail all not Keyless
features:
This script would basically be an all-in-one powerhouse tool, giving you total control and fun in Brookhaven. Typical features could include:

🏃‍♂️ Speed & Fly Hacks – run insanely fast across the map or fly around with ease.

🚗 Vehicle Mods – instantly spawn cars, make them super fast, or add crazy effects.

🏡 House Controls – unlock any house, grab premium houses for free, or place furniture anywhere.

😂 Trolling Features – fling other players, go invisible, change your size (tiny/giant), or crash people’s games.

💰 Fake Money / Items – create the illusion of being rich with cash rains or spawned items (visual only).

🛡 Godmode – become invincible so no one can kick, trap, or mess with you.

🎭 Clean GUI – everything accessible with neat buttons, toggles, and dropdowns.
